text: {"rules":[{"id":"PERINATAL-DEPRESSION-COUNSEL","version":"February 2019","title":"Counseling interventions for pregnant and postpartum persons at increased risk of perinatal depression","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends that clinicians provide or refer pregnant and postpartum persons who are at increased risk of perinatal depression to counseling interventions.","grade":"B","effective_date":"February 2019","action":"Provide or refer to counseling interventions","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"any\": [{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"pregnancy\"}, \"quote\": \"pregnant\"}, {\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"postpartum\"}, \"quote\": \"postpartum persons\"}], \"quote\": \"pregnant and postpartum persons\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"clinician assessment of increased risk of perinatal depression (risk factors not reliably held in structured EHR data)\"}, \"quote\": \"at increased risk of perinatal depression\"}], \"quote\": \"pregnant and postpartum persons who are at increased risk of perinatal depression\"}","numerator":"{\"any\": [{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"perinatal_depression_counseling\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"counseling interventions\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text gives no interval; counseling assumed to be within the measurement year in which the person is pregnant or postpartum\"}}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"documentation of referral to counseling interventions\"}, \"quote\": \"provide or refer\"}], \"quote\": \"provide or refer\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The denominator requires 'increased risk of perinatal depression', which depends on clinician assessment of risk factors; encoded as uncomputable, so the rule as a whole will report 'not computable' unless a risk flag is added.","New concept 'perinatal_depression_counseling' (counseling interventions such as CBT or interpersonal therapy for perinatal depression prevention) is not in the vocabulary.","Referral to counseling (as opposed to provided counseling) is encoded as uncomputable because referral completion is not reliably in structured data.","The text specifies no time window, counseling type, number of sessions or timing relative to pregnancy/postpartum; the measurement-year window is derived and requires human review.","The text does not define the duration of the postpartum period; the 'postpartum' concept is used as-is."]}
